# The Knovas Core's MCP gateway and its agents' claims (external)

> The Core's MCP gateway (https://mcp.knovas.ch/mcp), through which external agents read, and the Secure API's pool of each agent's Platform-signed claims that the gateway spends, one per upstream call, as far as the Platform relies on them.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY` |
| Kind | external |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |

## Purpose

### Not responsible for

- Deciding an agent's groups; the Platform signs them (its roles, narrowed to its person), and the Core only verifies each claim with the tenant's registered broker key.
- Holding the agent's key on the Platform; Knovas issues it with the agent's id (manage_mcp_keys --agent) and the gateway keeps its hash.
- Anything this repository builds; the gateway's and the Secure API's code, cards and tests live in KnowledgeBase.

### Terms

- agent id (the Platform's id of an agent; the subject of its claims and the id its gateway key is bound to)
- pool (the unused claims the Core holds for one agent; a PUT replaces it, a DELETE drops it)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent-claims-put` | PUT /secured/agents/{agent_id}/claims - replace the agent's pool with {"claims": [...]}, 1 to 20 claims (CR-R5) | http | `PUT /secured/agents/{agent_id}/claims` |
| `agent-claims-delete` | DELETE /secured/agents/{agent_id}/claims - drop the agent's pool at once (CR-R5) | http | `DELETE /secured/agents/{agent_id}/claims` |
| `mcp` | POST https://mcp.knovas.ch/mcp - the gateway's tools search and fetch, called by an external agent with its agent-bound key (CR-R6); the Platform does not call it | http | `POST /mcp` |

## Contract

### `*` (every operation)

#### Always

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY/*/A-1` | The tenant of every pool call is the one the caller's client certificate names; a request never names it, and a claim for another tenant is refused. | critical |

### `agent-claims-put`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY/agent-claims-put/P-1` | Takes exactly {"claims": [...]}, 1 to 20 claims, each verified like a person's (typ knovas-principal+jws, EdDSA, a key registered for the tenant, sub = the agent id, exp - iat at most 300 seconds, at most 32 groups) without burning its jti, and replaces the agent's whole pool (204). One bad claim refuses the request (400 invalid_claims), nothing stored; a tenant not brokered answers 409 not_brokered, nothing stored. | critical |

### `agent-claims-delete`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY/agent-claims-delete/P-1` | Drops the agent's pool at once and answers 204, also when it has none. | critical |

### `mcp`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY/mcp/P-1` | A call with an agent-bound key sends exactly one unused, unexpired claim of that agent upstream as principal_assertion with the actor {"kind": "agent", "id": &lt;agent id>}, and a retry takes a fresh one; with no unused claim nothing is read and it answers busy when the pool of the last five minutes is used up, "No current rights for this agent" when there is none. | critical |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY/mcp/L-1` | An agent makes at most as many upstream calls a minute as the Platform pushes claims a minute (20, the pool's maximum, once a minute). | standard |
